title: More on Repealing the Laws of Economics
summary:
Before the devastating fires of 2025, California's fire insurance market was already in a state
of crisis, shaped by a combination of regulatory constraints insurer with draws and mounting
wildfire ri Insurers were prohibited from using forward-looking catastrophe models to set rates for wildfire
risk. This approach became increasingly problematic as wildfires grew more frequent and severe,
making historical data a poor predictor of future risk.
